# P2P SSH Attach Sync Direction

## Goal
EMA should support a family of access/coordination modes:
- local-first
- SSH attach
- peer-to-peer-ish remote presence where feasible
- shared workspace/session sync
- device and host awareness

## What matters most
Not branding the transport.
What matters is the user experience that:
- the workspace persists
- sessions are attachable
- remote hosts feel native to the workspace
- humans and agents can rendezvous in the same context

## Non-goals
- inventing a totally bespoke remote desktop stack before core workspace semantics exist
- conflating file sync, session sync, and live presence into one blurry idea

## Better framing
Separate:
- file/object sync
- session attach/mirror
- host control
- graph/query access
- approval/security boundaries
